actual_linux_lifecycle_and_browser.environment: Linux arm64 App, separate real source and clone Go worker processes, network-none Docker, owned loopback qB endpoints. Chrome 157 used the actual embedded Vue/Vuetify UI over a loopback-only byte bridge.
actual_linux_lifecycle_and_browser.observed: Clone inherited disabled configuration and acquired its own worker and empty data namespace. Source and clone executed one scheduled scan each. Both reloads replaced their sessions. Cold startup reopened two sessions with independent config, history and same-key material files. No consumed one-shot replayed.
actual_linux_lifecycle_and_browser.browser_observed: The actual clone card opened 19 native Vuetify labels. Chrome made one configuration PUT and reopened the persisted label. Host readback verified clone marker and unchanged source config with no scan replay.

actual_linux_lifecycle_and_browser.browser_observer_notes: Initial browser route used an extra slash and timed out. The subsequent real save returned HTTP 200.
